card.name: Words just before animal species names
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation right before a named animal or species, in wildlife and zoology articles. Examples are 'the', ':', ',' and 'called' leading into names like quoll or bushbaby.

modes.label: Species lists
modes.description: Colons, commas, brackets and 'the' inside a list of animal species names.

modes.label: Lead-in to an animal
modes.description: A linking word such as 'called', 'related' or 'endangered' just before the animal is named.
modes.example: by looking at the genome of a small primate<< called>> a bushbaby.

card.plain: It fires on the small words that come just before an animal's name in nature writing.
